about.title: About
about.description: The purpose of this application is to collect author information from 5 prestigious international publishers namely Elsevier, Springer, John Wiley, World Scientific and Taylor & Francis. In fact, this application automates the collection process.
about.importantNotes: Important notes to consider when using the application:
about.note1: To use this application, make sure that Google Chrome browser is installed on your system.
about.note2: When the collection process starts, Chrome browser opens. If you close the browser, the collection process will end. So be careful.
about.note3: It is recommended not to use the opened browser. It may cause uncontrollable changes. (Using the Chrome browser that you opened yourself is fine)
about.note4: It is recommended to use an internet with appropriate speed.
about.note5: It is recommended that each time you use the application, if possible, use IP change software or proxies to prevent detection as a bot as much as possible.

extractSpeed.title: Extraction Speed
extractSpeed.description: Extraction speed refers to the time the program waits between navigating pages and then enters the new address process. The purpose of this section is to prevent detection by bot detection and automated systems as a bot.
extractSpeed.maximum_desc: In this mode, the program does not apply any speed restrictions and proceeds with maximum speed collection.
extractSpeed.high_desc: In this mode, page navigation occurs every 1 second. For example, moving from the volume page to the issue page, etc.
extractSpeed.medium_desc: In this mode, navigation occurs every 2 seconds.
extractSpeed.optimal_desc: In this mode, navigation occurs every 3.5 seconds. A middle ground that is likely to be suitable.
extractSpeed.low_desc: In this mode, page navigation occurs every 5 seconds. This prevents the target site's monitoring systems from identifying us as a bot.
extractSpeed.recommendation: If you are not in a hurry, it is recommended to use the "Low" option.

extractorType.title: Extractor Type
extractorType.description: The extractor is the part of the software responsible for searching pages and extracting information. In this application, 2 types of extractors are defined that can be used interchangeably depending on need and situation. For example, if your system has not yet encountered "I am not a robot" problems, we recommend the first option.
extractorType.type1_desc: This type, which is the default mode, is a stable and reliable mode that can perform searches with greater stability and less error. However, this type is helpless against robot detection methods like Cloudflare, and if you encounter "I am not a robot" challenges, you will need to manually solve the problem.
extractorType.type2_desc: This type works better against "I am not a robot" challenges and tries to solve them, but due to technical limitations, the likelihood of encountering errors is higher than type 1, and it may encounter problems in some challenge resolution scenarios.
